errores.resultado_no_confirmado: The result could not be confirmed. Retry the same check to retrieve its receipt.
errores.comprobacion_ofrecimiento_no_habilitada: This check is not enabled yet. Contact the administrator.
errores.comprobacion_en_conflicto: The details have changed. Refresh the record before registering the check.
errores.solicitud_invalida: Review the details of the check.
errores.acceso_denegado: You do not have permission to register this check. Contact the administrator.
errores.servicio_no_disponible: The check could not be registered. Please try again.

ficha.titulo: Check the details before offering the post
ficha.ayuda: Selection for the case has stopped at this person until HR checks their current relationship with the Provincial Council. Enter each detail and the document that proves it. Details from the registered contract are already filled in; review them. VEC works out the result when you register.
ficha.ayuda_huella: The file is read only on this computer to calculate its digital fingerprint and is not sent. The fingerprint lets anyone check later that the document is the same one: it does not prove that VEC keeps it and it is not a signature. Maximum size: {limite} MB.
ficha.detenida: Selection for the case has stopped at position {posicion}. Check this person's details.
ficha.rectificacion: A check is already registered (version {version}). The new one replaces it.
ficha.documento_referencia: Reference of the document you keep
ficha.documento_referencia_pista: Registry or case number. No spaces and no personal data.
ficha.grupo_puesto: Post offered and place on the list
ficha.hecho_trabaja_en_diputacion: Currently works at the Provincial Council
ficha.hecho_causa_relacion_pista: Key as it appears on the contract, for example baja.
ficha.hecho_fin_previsto: Expected end of the current contract
ficha.hecho_fecha_inicial_baja: Start of the leave of the person replaced
ficha.hecho_es_vacante: The post offered is a vacancy
ficha.revision_titulo: Review the details before registering them
ficha.recibo_recuperada: This check was already registered; its receipt is shown.
ficha.siguiente_paso: Go back to the case and run the selection again.
ficha.resultado_no_aplicable: The job improvement rule does not apply
ficha.motivo_antecedentes_incompletos: Details or documents are missing to decide.
ficha.motivo_criterios_invalidos: The list's offer rule is not valid. Tell the person who manages it.
ficha.motivo_guarda_contratacion_pendiente: A job improvement case applies; the selection will check the time limit.
ficha.motivo_descuento_pendiente_criterio_rrhh: A case applies, but HR has not yet set how to deduct the time worked.
ficha.motivo_sin_supuesto_articulo_9: The person is not in any job improvement case under article 9 of the Regulation.
ficha.error_sin_hechos: Enter at least one detail with the document that proves it.
ficha.error_documento_referencia: Enter a valid reference for document {numero}: 3 to 256 letters, digits or the signs . _ : / # -, with no spaces or ID numbers.
ficha.error_documento_calculando: Wait until the file for document {numero} has been checked.
ficha.error_hecho_sin_valor: Enter the value of “{hecho}” or remove its document.
ficha.error_hecho_clave: “{hecho}” only accepts lower-case letters without accents, digits and the signs . _ -.
ficha.incierto: We could not confirm whether the check was registered. Select Retry: the same check is recovered, without duplicating it.
ficha.no_en_pagina: The person at position {posicion} is not on this page of the list. Find them and open their record to check their details.

huella.comprobado: Document checked on this computer; its content is not stored.
huella.calculando: Checking the document on this computer…
huella.sin_archivo: Choose the document file to continue.
huella.demasiado_grande: The file is larger than {limite} MB. Choose a lighter copy of the document.
huella.vacio: The file is empty. Choose the right document.
huella.no_disponible: This browser cannot check the document. Use an up-to-date browser.
huella.error_lectura: The file could not be read. Choose it again.
